title: Reserve and settle an in-memory tenant budget
prompt: Return a thread-safe single-tenant integer budget ledger with reserve/settle/refund. Reservations use unique request IDs; replay must match amounts. Reject over-budget reservations. Settlement records actual incurred cost even above estimate/limit, leaving negative availability if necessary; it cannot erase provider usage. This is in-memory, not durable accounting.
